The '''stalker lizard''' was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Possessing a purple-blue skin [[Color/Legends|color]] and moving relatively low to the ground, the animal perfectly matched the color of the native grasses, making it a stealthily-camouflaged pack-predator. They dined on [[nettar]]s in the early morning and evening, and could grow to over three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length.
